newsitem.title: UK: Saudi cuts March crude prices for U.S. customers.
newsitem.headline: Saudi cuts March crude prices for U.S. customers.

text.p: Saudi Arabia has cut the price of its crude oil for U.S. customers in March by between 10 and 55 cents a barrel, traders said on Tuesday.
Arab Light has been cut by 25 cents to West Texas Intermediate (WTI) -$3.30 a barrel, Arab Medium by 40 cents to WTI -$4.35 and Arab Heavy by 55 cents to WTI -$5.20 a barrel, they said.
Berri Extra Light was cut by 10 cents to WTI -$2.15 a barrel, traders added.
Traders said earlier Saudi Arabia cut the price of its Arab Medium and Heavy crudes for both European and Asian customers.
Arab Light to Europe was left unchanged while Berri Extra Light was raised by five cents. Super Light to Asia was also raised, by 20 cents a barrel.
